stem:
Lavanya wants to learn the Class 7 science chapter well. The chapter invites learners to move beyond only reading.

Which plan best matches that view of learning science?

options.text: Read the section, then observe a related everyday event and try the suggested activity or experiment while thinking carefully about what happens.
Skip the book entirely and learn only by doing random activities and experiments.
Sit outdoors with the book open and read the same page again, because being outside is better science learning than a classroom experiment.
Memorise every bold word in the chapter and stop there.

teacher.key_rationale: Learning science joins reading with observing and doing careful activities—not reading alone, memorising alone, or skipping the book.
